title: Gemini Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Gemini (May 21 – June 20) is the curious, talkative air sign ruled by Mercury. Quick-witted and playful, Gemini collects ideas, people and stories everywhere it goes.
personality: Gemini has a mind that never stops. They love learning a little about everything, switching topics and making unexpected connections. Social and funny, they can talk to anyone and adapt to any room. Their changing moods are part of their charm: there is always a new side of Gemini to discover. Routine bores them, while conversation and variety feed them.
weaknesses: Starts more projects than they finish
love: Gemini falls for minds first. They need a partner who can chat for hours, laugh at their jokes and keep life interesting. Freedom and trust matter; boredom is the real deal-breaker.
career: Gemini thrives in media, writing, teaching, marketing, sales, travel and tech roles that change often and involve people and information.
friendship: Gemini knows everyone and connects people. As a friend they bring fun plans, fresh news and the best advice on what to try next.

faq.q: What is the Gemini personality like?
faq.ans: Gemini is curious, social, witty and adaptable, with a fast and restless mind.

faq.q: Who is Gemini most compatible with?
faq.ans: Gemini usually clicks with Libra, Aquarius and Aries.

faq.q: What is the lucky day of Gemini?
faq.ans: Wednesday, the day linked to Mercury, is considered lucky for Gemini.
